_comment: Prompt = styles[style] (objects[style] for emoji marked object) + ', ' + subject + ', ' + framing. Positive text only describes what we want: in I1/I2 Qwen-Image drew the very things a 'no ...' phrase named (human silhouettes, limbs). Exclusions go to negative + negative_style[style] + negative_object (objects) or negative_head (subjects 'shown as a head only'); they act because cfg 2.5 > 1. All three styles ship (2026-11-13): paper is free, marker and clay are in-app packs. See docs/EMOJI_SET_PLAN.md §6.
_ship: Styles the app shows, in picker order; the first is the default and free. pack = id in handwritten_stickers/assets/packs/packs.json.

styles.marker: hand-drawn illustration in felt-tip marker and coloured pencil, confident visible strokes, slightly uneven dark brown ink outline, bold flat colours with light paper grain inside the shapes
styles.paper: flat paper-craft illustration: one main piece of coloured paper cut to the exact outline of the subject, with the smaller details cut from paper and glued on top of it, clean scissor-cut edges, a thin soft shadow under each detail, light gouache texture, the cut-out edge of the main piece is the outer edge of the whole picture
styles.clay: soft 3D clay model, rounded smooth plasticine shapes with a satin finish, gentle studio light, vivid colours

objects.clay: a small handmade plasticine object on its own, like a studio product shot, smooth rounded shapes with a satin finish, gentle studio light, vivid colours, the plain object exactly as it is in real life
objects.paper: flat paper-craft illustration of a single object: one main piece of coloured paper cut to the exact outline of the object, with the smaller details cut from paper and glued on top of it, clean scissor-cut edges, a thin soft shadow under each detail, light gouache texture, the cut-out edge of the main piece is the outer edge of the whole picture

framing: one single isolated subject shown whole, centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame, floating freely in empty space in front of a plain flat medium grey background
negative: text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, logo, frame, border, white sticker outline, several subjects, cropped subject, photograph, realistic human skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, ground shadow, floor, pedestal

negative_style.paper: person, people, human figure, human silhouette, stack of paper, stacked paper squares, coloured paper layers behind the subject, square background, backing card, mounting board, white rim

negative_object: face, eyes, mouth, arms, legs, feet, hands, body, mascot, cartoon character, person, figure holding it
negative_head: arms, hands, legs, feet, body, torso

seed._formula: seed = base + per_item * n + k; k = 0..3 (hands category 0..7), retries continue with the next k

negative_hand: face, eyes, mouth, text, letters, sleeve, shirt, torso, person, character body
negative_face: torso, shoulders, sleeve, shirt, legs, feet, body
